verdict.rationale: vLLM's GitHub README and website document installation via uv or pip, with `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto`. An official Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai) is also on Docker Hub, and building from source is presented as an option for development only. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the prebuilt install works, and documentation of which hardware backends have prebuilt wheels versus needing a source build.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: Install vLLM with uv (recommended) or pip:
vLLM offers an official Docker image for deployment. The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
Or build from source for development.
